root_cause.text: The private IOCTL handlers implemented in the `atomisp_vidioc_default` function of the `atomisp` driver contain unsafe operations and lack proper security validation.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds an immediate check `if (cmd) return -EINVAL;` at the beginning of `atomisp_vidioc_default` to disable all private IOCTLs, and the commit message notes that these handlers "aren't quite as safe as one could assume".

intent_record.intent_summary: Disable all private IOCTLs in the atomisp driver by immediately returning -EINVAL.
intent_record.what: Added a conditional check at the beginning of the atomisp_vidioc_default function to return -EINVAL if the cmd parameter is non-zero.
intent_record.how: This change immediately rejects all incoming private IOCTL commands, preventing any subsequent driver logic in this function from executing.

This commit reverts the removal of the driver, bringing back the vulnerable code without any fixes.
